Positive GEX ($826M) is creating a 'pinned' regime where dealers are short gamma, making markets more vulnerable to sudden moves. The CAG of 0.88 (BEAR-DELUDED) suggests market participants are overly optimistic despite deteriorating medium-term conditions.
